name: Daniel Ziegler
statement_summary: Resigned from OpenAI in July 2025 citing safety concerns; departure reported publicly alongside other safety staff resignations.

name: William Saunders
statement_summary: Departed OpenAI in February 2024 after signing a public letter warning of unaddressed safety concerns at the company.

name: Pavel Izmailov
statement_summary: Resigned from OpenAI in June 2025 with a public resignation letter detailing safety-related concerns.

name: Suchir Balaji
statement_summary: Resigned from OpenAI in October 2024 over concerns about data use and copyright; found deceased in November 2024.

name: Cullen O'Keefe
statement_summary: Reported to have resigned from OpenAI in July 2025 alongside other safety staff; details not independently confirmed.

name: Helen Toner
statement_summary: Removed from the OpenAI board in November 2023; publicly criticized board governance and safety oversight.

name: Miles Brundage
statement_summary: Departed OpenAI in October 2024, publishing a long essay on policy and safety concerns in frontier AI development.

name: Jan Leike
statement_summary: Left OpenAI in May 2024 with a public thread saying safety culture had been deprioritized; joined Anthropic.

name: Timnit Gebru
statement_summary: Terminated from Google in December 2020 after a dispute over a research paper on large language model harms.

name: Margaret Mitchell
statement_summary: Fired from Google in February 2021 in the aftermath of Timnit Gebru's departure; co-led the ethical AI team.

name: Frances Haugen
statement_summary: Left Facebook in 2021 and disclosed internal documents about platform harms in the Facebook Papers disclosures.

name: Peiter Zatko
statement_summary: Filed a whistleblower complaint in 2022 alleging security and privacy failures at Twitter after his January 2022 departure.

name: Maren Costa
statement_summary: Fired from Amazon in February 2020 after publicly advocating for climate action and speaking about warehouse conditions.

name: Sophie Zhang
statement_summary: Published a farewell memo in September 2020 describing election integrity failures she said were ignored.

name: Susan Fowler
statement_summary: Published a February 2017 account of harassment and HR failures at Uber that triggered a company-wide investigation.

name: Ava Reyes
statement_summary: Departed citing unresolved safety-disclosure disagreements; statement flagged for verification against public filings.

name: Leo Nakamura
statement_summary: Resigned after internal review of model-capability reporting; no public statement issued at time of capture.

name: Mara Chen
statement_summary: Left the trust-and-safety group; departure attributed to restructuring, retaliation claims unverified.
